test_cases.prompt: This is too big for one session. Help me map out the approach.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wayfinder skill to chart a shared map of decision tickets on the issue tracker.
test_cases.notes: Huge foggy effort is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: We're starting a greenfield project. Where do we begin?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wayfinder skill to map decisions (tech stack, architecture, data model) for the greenfield project.
test_cases.notes: Greenfield project is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: We don't know enough yet. Resolve the unknowns first.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wayfinder skill to create research tickets for resolving unknowns in the fog of war.
test_cases.notes: Fog clearing is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Break this spec into tickets for implementation.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill instead. To-tickets breaks specs into work items; wayfinder maps decisions until the spec emerges.
test_cases.notes: to-tickets is the sibling skill for breaking specs into tickets.

test_cases.prompt: Sharpen my design ideas through an interview.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill instead. Grill-with-docs sharpens an idea you can hold; wayfinder maps an idea you can't hold.
test_cases.notes: grill-with-docs is the sibling skill for idea sharpening.

test_cases.prompt: Read the official documentation for this library.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill instead. Research reads primary sources; wayfinder manages a map of decisions.
test_cases.notes: research is the sibling skill for reading documentation.

test_cases.prompt: This migration will take weeks. Map out the decisions we need to make.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wayfinder skill to map migration decisions. Edge case: migration is large but concrete — tests whether wayfinder maps decisions or if to-tickets should break it into work items.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: large but concrete migration tests wayfinder vs to-tickets boundary.
